request: Run exact DebugAI PR112 Gate regression inside existing Docker image with read-only source mounts; no deploy.

bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/.worktrees/pr112-gates-20261016; test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD)" = "bb08aef1d92271d1fb4ab9f37309535811d48180" || exit 23; c=$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai); test "$(printf '%s\n' "$c" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 31; im=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$c"); test -n "$im"; docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=64m --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --memory 768m --cpus 1 -v "$p/server:/app/server:ro" -v "$p/compose.yaml:/app/compose.yaml:ro" -w /app "$im" node --test server/tests/ai-core-gate-preflight.test.cjs >/tmp/dbg-pr112-docker-test.log 2>&1 || { tail -n 12 /tmp/dbg-pr112-docker-test.log; exit 32; }
